admission.justification: Stripping literal property names ('title', 'default', 'description') or non-null defaults, or alias-mutating caller schemas, silently corrupts MCP tool wire contracts; guarded directly by test_compact_tool_schema_is_lossless_and_immutable.

applicability: Applies to every JSON Schema mapping passed to compact_tool_schema in mcp/src/agents_remember/models/tools/tool_schema_compaction.py.
conditions: Input is a JSON Schema mapping produced for an MCP tool's inputSchema.
Schema-keyword stripping operates only on schema nodes, never on property-name or definition-name maps ($defs, properties, patternProperties, dependentSchemas).
exclusions: Does not rewrite anyOf nullability, inline or rename $defs entries, strip field-level property descriptions, or alter non-null defaults.
statement: compact_tool_schema returns an unaliased deep copy of one MCP tool JSON Schema that strips only schema-level title, default: null, and immediate top-level $defs model-level description strings while preserving literal title, default, and description property names, combinators, dependentSchemas, list and dict items, additionalProperties, required, enum, const, $ref, and non-null defaults.
